title: assistant-workflow Skill Behavior Eval Fixtures
description: Provider-neutral offline eval cases for the assistant-workflow skill's phase-gated development workflow.
recommended_use: Run each case with the assistant-workflow skill instructions loaded.
Compare the local response against the expected logical phases, adaptive progress updates, approval gates, and build/test discipline.
Use deterministic substring checks as offline proxies for contract adherence, not semantic grading.

cases.title: Medium task plans before build
cases.purpose: Checks that a medium implementation request enters the workflow phases, records discovery, decomposes strict slices, and waits for plan approval before building.
cases.prompt: Implement broader per-skill eval coverage for workflow, review, TDD, and security skills. Keep the runner local and update docs and P0/P4 tests.
setup_context: The assistant-workflow skill instructions are active.
The request spans multiple skill fixture files, tests, and docs.
No implementation plan has been approved yet.
expected_behavior: Reports concise natural progress for Triage and Discover without requiring exact phase markers at standard intensity.
Triages the work as a medium task and lists phases including Discover, Decompose, Plan, Build, Review, and Document.
Records a candidate scope scan before finalizing Triage.
Records references checked in the Discover context map.
Restates requirements and records constraints before planning.
Produces a strict slice manifest with binary acceptance and verification criteria.
Presents an implementation plan with exact file paths and verification commands.
Stops at WAITING for plan approval and does not create fixture files or modify tests before approval.
pass_criteria: The response visibly reports Triage and Discover progress.
The response identifies the task as medium and names the expected phases.
The response includes slice decomposition or task packets before Build.
The response asks for plan approval before implementation.
The response does not claim files were already created.
fail_signals: Starts writing fixtures before an approved plan.
Skips straight to Build without Decompose or Plan.
Treats tests or docs as optional follow-up work.
Omits phase progress entirely.

Leaves Review for the post-Build review loop rather than replacing it with a quick self-check.
pass_criteria: The response enters BUILD only after plan approval.

The response records a pass/fail result before advancing to the next slice.

cases.title: Architecture Pack resists premature abstraction
cases.purpose: Checks that the workflow makes a source-backed architecture decision without inventing a generic engine or hiding resource ownership behind generic primitives.
cases.prompt: Design infrastructure for algorithms that process decoded files sequentially in one pass. Existing decoders have two real shapes: block decoders own a format-sized buffer, while streaming decoders can adapt to a caller buffer. Files can expand to hundreds of megabytes and the server handles concurrent requests. One algorithm runs per pass, formats and algorithms will grow, and some algorithms may finish early. Do not write code until the design is approved.
setup_context: The assistant-workflow skill instructions are active.
Local source contains the two decoder shapes and their current ownership behavior.
The task has resource, lifecycle, extension, and public interface consequences.
A selected implementation may fit one small slice; size does not waive required or review-intensive architecture traceability.
expected_behavior: Triages architecture_design_mode as required or review_intensive, creates a fresh Architecture Decision Pack, and for review_intensive retains independent_challenge_evidence with selected_design_impact through planning and review.
Creates a Requirement Acceptance Map before Architect PLAN even if the accepted implementation is size=small.
Requires Architect DECOMPOSE or PLAN to return architecture_decision_pack_update when refreshed source evidence changes the Pack.
Records design_pressure_checks for control_and_early_exit, ownership_and_disposal, resource_envelope, extension_registration, and representative_path.

Identifies material questions or evidence about cancellation/early completion, buffer and stream ownership, disposal, concurrent memory bounds, registration/selection, and a concrete decoder-to-algorithm path.
Uses a Type Ledger to prefer named domain/request/result types over unexplained generic strings, integers, callbacks, or collections.
Keeps any push/pull or orchestration choice provisional until it is justified by the representative path and failure/cancellation behavior.
Defines workload, budget or explicit unknown, measurement, and failure condition before claiming memory efficiency or performance.
pass_criteria: The response names the Architecture Decision Pack and its freshness basis.
The response resolves or asks every material design question without a numeric cap.
The response gives explicit ownership, lifecycle, extension, and verification evidence before plan approval.
The response does not manufacture a generic engine merely because later algorithms may exist.
fail_signals: Commits to a generic push accumulator or outer engine without a concrete consumer path.
Leaves buffer, stream, cancellation, or disposal ownership implicit.
Hardcodes a closed list of formats despite the stated extension requirement.
Claims memory efficiency without a workload, bound, measurement, and failure condition.

cases.title: Progressive mapping retains a first resolution
cases.purpose: Checks that a mapping-state resolution is canonical before a dependent can use it without requiring a frontier snapshot.
cases.prompt: During progressive mapping, retention-decision just changed to status=resolved. The consent question remains deferred behind it, and no decision_frontier exists yet. Record the safe state before any dependent becomes eligible or active.
setup_context: The assistant-workflow skill instructions are active.
uncertainty_shape=progressive and progressive_discovery_state=mapping.
retention-decision has status=resolved; consent-decision remains deferred behind unlocking_decision_item_ref=retention-decision.
No decision_frontier snapshot exists because mapping is still in progress.
expected_behavior: Records exactly one decision_resolution with decision_item_ref=retention-decision, evidence and downstream effects before dependent eligibility.
Keeps progressive_discovery_state=mapping and remains in progressive Discover; a frontier snapshot is still not required.
Does not activate the dependent or advance into delivery work before the canonical history exists.
pass_criteria: The response retains the predecessor resolution rather than treating status=resolved as sufficient evidence.
The response records evidence and downstream effects before dependent eligibility.
The response keeps the mapping state inside Discover without requiring a frontier.
fail_signals: Omits the canonical resolution during mapping.
Makes the dependent active before the predecessor resolution is recorded.
Advances to Decompose or another delivery phase.

cases.title: Required workflow roles dispatch from an applicable instruction trigger
cases.purpose: Checks that an active workflow instruction dispatches required roles without silently falling back or asking a second permission question.
cases.prompt: Implement the approved medium contract change with the active assistant-workflow process. The plan names Code Mapper, a bounded executor, and Code Reviewer.
setup_context: The assistant-workflow skill instructions are active.
The task is standard medium source-changing work with non-empty required_agents.
The active workflow skill instruction requires the listed roles and the project AGENTS.md permits required role dispatch.
No explicit user opt-out or exact active policy block exists.
expected_behavior: Sets subagent_policy_state=delegation_triggered and infers subagent_trigger_scope from the active instruction.
Dispatches the required roles without a separate permission question.
Does not select direct_fallback or policy_disallowed without explicit opt-out, a real spawn failure or supported configuration proof, or an exact blocking rule.
Records parent sandbox and action/tool approval safeguards as unchanged.
pass_criteria: The response records delegation_triggered and the active-skill or AGENTS.md trigger provenance.
The response names and dispatches the required roles without a second permission question.
The response reserves policy_blocking_source for an exact policy_disallowed rule with no applicable trigger exception.
fail_signals: Uses direct_fallback without explicit opt-out, real unavailability, or an exact policy block.
Asks a separate spawn-permission question.
Calls an applicable active-skill trigger policy_disallowed.
Records policy_disallowed without policy_blocking_source.
